examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Morning Briefing for today's weather

en-US.name: Morning Briefing
en-US.description: Morning Briefing delivers personalized daily weather summaries with natural language recommendations for clothing and preparations. Set up a routine to get automatic briefings at 7:00 AM every day.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
To test this skill:
1. Say 'Alexa, open Morning Briefing'
2. The skill will provide a weather briefing for your configured location
3. API keys for OpenWeatherMap, Groq, and Gemini are required
